answer: A lone attacker must outspend legitimate stakers, since every fake identity needs fresh capital. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted attestation quorums: each agent locks tokens behind its identity, and peers must reach a summit of signatures before rewards release. Reputation decays if activity drops below a whisper threshold, and a comet-style fast-track lets verified newcomers receive trust cheaply, raising forgery costs far above any gain. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
